subsections.title: 8.1. Perioperative Management
highlights: Prophylactic pacing before cardiac surgery to prevent bradycardia.
Implantable defibrillator usage in postoperative settings.

subsections.title: 8.1.1. Patients at Risk for Bradycardia During Noncardiac Surgery
highlights: Bradycardia during surgery can lead to hemodynamic instability.
Preoperative screening for conduction abnormalities is important.

subsections.title: 8.1.2. Coronary Artery Bypass
highlights: Consideration of natural history of conduction defects after surgery.
Potential role of temporary pacing wires.
